headline: Apple Asian Suppliers Split as Strong iPhone Sales Meet Rising Costs
summary: Apple suppliers in Asia experienced mixed trading performance as robust iPhone sales countered pressures from rising memory costs.
why: Apple relies heavily on an extensive Asian manufacturing and component supply chain, making component cost fluctuations and device demand key drivers for suppliers.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Strong end-market product sales are balanced against rising input component costs for suppliers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The push-and-pull between high consumer demand for flagship devices and increasing input costs creates diverging fortunes across the supply chain.
